visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair sits on a white textured sofa, holding a gold-cased smartphone and scrolling. A woman with long black hair, wearing a white polo shirt and a black mini-skirt, leans over his shoulder from behind in a brightly lit indoor living room. (2) The woman suddenly grabs the phone and looks at the screen, which displays a photo of another woman. She becomes visibly angry, waving her arms and swatting at the man as he tries to shield himself. (3) The man is shown with a bandage on his cheek and a bruised eye effect. He is looking at his phone again. The woman, now wearing a green sleeveless dress, leans in curiously. (4) The camera shows a close-up of the smartphone screen displaying an Instagram post of a girl posing with boxed products. The man then holds up a box of '昕顏葉黃素靈光凍' (Lutein Jelly) near his face. (5) The woman stands in front of a white curtain, talking directly to the camera with animated hand gestures and smiles. She holds up three thin yellow jelly packets to the lens. (6) The man holds his phone toward the camera, showing a webpage with discount information and 42% off graphics. The woman appears excited, cheering with her fists clenched. (7) The man is back on his phone, scrolling through photos of a woman in a bikini. The woman's face slowly appears from behind the sofa, staring at him. (8) The man is now shown tied up with white rope and blue tape over his mouth. The woman stands next to him, holding the product box and speaking enthusiastically to the camera. (9) The woman holds a jelly packet to the man's mouth while he is still tied up. He takes a bite. The video ends with screen recordings of the brand's official website and promotional banners.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat synth-pop BGM starts. A female voice speaks in a warm, questioning tone, followed by a male voice responding calmly. (2) A loud, sharp 'slap' SFX cuts the music momentarily, followed by the female voice shouting in an angry, high-pitched tone. (3) A cartoonish 'slide-whistle' down-pitch SFX plays over a moment of relative silence. (4) The BGM resumes. The female voice returns to a playful, inquisitive tone. The male voice explains himself with moderate speed. (5) A bright 'ding' SFX sounds as a new phase starts. The female voice expresses surprise with a high-pitched rising intonation. (6) A series of quick 'pop' SFX accompany the dialogue as the characters discuss the product. The speech rate is fast and energetic. (7) A high-pitched cheering sound effect is triggered by the female as she discusses the discount. (8) The audio suddenly ducks to a whisper. A low, creepy female voice says 'Caught you,' accompanied by a subtle suspenseful drone. (9) The upbeat BGM returns with high intensity. The female voice delivers a structured promotional pitch with clear articulation. Muffled, rhythmic grunting sounds from the male character are heard in the background. (10) The music fades out with a final high-energy synth chord.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict -> Product Integration -> Reward -> Twist -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic skit about a jealous girlfriend catching her boyfriend looking at other women to pivot into a product recommendation for eye health supplements (昕顏葉黃素靈光凍). It aims to capture attention through relatable relationship humor before transitioning into an explicit commercial endorsement of a Mother's Day sale.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, demonstration of consumption, and explicit mention of brand name and promotional links.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends social media comedy tropes with direct response marketing. The high density of text overlays and rapid scene cuts are characteristic of short-form mobile video advertisements designed for high engagement.
